verdict.rationale: Docs and community evidence confirm typed agents (Agent[Foobar, list[str]]) with IDE-checked dependency/output types, simple @agent.tool decorators for function tools, and typed structured outputs via Pydantic models — a core, well-documented design goal. Community reviewers explicitly praise how easy it is to construct agents and note 'frictionless tool-calling', though some cite friction with advanced/edge-case usage.
